summary: Provide your own automation mesh CA by setting mesh_ca_keyfile and mesh_ca_certfile in [all:vars]; the installer copies it to /etc/receptor/tls/ca/ on each node, and generates a CA if you give none.
questions: How do I use my own CA for automation mesh?
Where does receptor store the mesh CA?

answer_card.title: Import a CA for automation mesh
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[all:vars]
mesh_ca_keyfile=/tmp/<mesh_CA>.key
mesh_ca_certfile=/tmp/<mesh_CA>.crt
```
Run the installer; it copies the CA to `/etc/receptor/tls/ca/` on each control and execution node. Without these, the installer generates a CA.
